title: open-rag-eval: RAG Evaluation without "golden" answers — Ofer Mendelevitch, Vectara
talk_summary: Vectara presents open-rag-eval, an open-source RAG evaluation toolkit that avoids golden answers by scoring retrieved chunks and generated answers with reference-free metrics and LLM judges. It provides connectors, evaluator output files, and a UI for comparing queries and scores.

takeaways.what_they_do: Break expected answer content into atomic nuggets, rate them vital/ok, keep the top 20, then have an LLM judge check whether the RAG response fully or partially supports each nugget.
takeaways.evidence_quote: an LLM judge analyzes the response you get from your rag to determine if each of the selected nuggets is either fully supported or partially supported

takeaways.what_they_do: Grade each cited passage as fully supported, partially supported, or unsupported by the response.
takeaways.evidence_quote: citation faithfulness which essentially measures whether the citation the passage you know is high fidelity

takeaways.what_they_do: Score each retrieved chunk from 0 to 3 for relevance to the query, where 3 contains the exact answer.
takeaways.evidence_quote: takes a chunk and gives it a score between zero and three

takeaways.what_they_do: Connectors collect pipeline outputs, evaluators produce standardized evaluation files, and a UI compares queries and scores.
takeaways.evidence_quote: rag connector and that really collects all the actual information, the actual chunks, the actual answers
